supported_findings.expected: Retry restores hp/score/checkpoint but fails to restore ammo=30; observed ammo remains 0.
Keyboard E activates the terminal while harness-generated gamepad X does not under the same in-range contract.
Loading the pre-boss-key checkpoint incorrectly restores bossDoorUnlocked=true while bossKey remains false.

required_boundaries: Automated harness input is not human playtest evidence.
Harness-generated gamepad input is not physical-device certification.
Observed state mismatch does not establish source-code root cause.
Absent rendering/performance/network/audio/accessibility evidence remains untested rather than inferred.

dimensions.anchor: Identifies all three supported regressions without weakening the exact contract.
Adds no unsupported defect/quality claims from absent evidence.
Provides exact reproducible steps, expected state and observed state for supported findings.
Separates automated traces from human/device/render evidence and distinguishes observation from inference.
Does not invent root causes; records material unknowns and the evidence needed next.
Routes implementation/root-cause or physical/human validation to the appropriate next evidence/owner rather than self-certifying it.

evaluation_rules: Evaluator sees anonymized outputs only; role-only vs Professional-Body mapping is revealed after scoring.
Use the same rubric for both arms.
A blocked or incomplete arm remains part of the experiment record.
One pair of scores cannot support a general body-effect claim.
